newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mexican leader to visit Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Mexican leader to visit Singapore.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo will lead a business delegation to Singapore on November 26-28 to strengthen bilateral ties, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) said on Monday.
Zedillo is scheduled to speak to local business leaders in the city-state and hold talks with Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong, the MFA said in a statement.
The Mexican leader is currently in the Philippines attending the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' summit.
